ns2:section.sectionText: This course includes a practicum/lab requirement for the middle 8 weeks of the semester. During the 8 weeks of the classroom only portion, students will meet in the classroom from 1:00-3:50. During the practicum/lab portion, students will meet in class from 1:00-3:50 and will also be scheduled in one of three time blocks between 4:00 and 8:30 PM. Dates are: TBD Please contact MSW Program Director or Instructor if you have questions.
